title: The observational partial order of causal structures with latent variables
abstract: arXiv:2502.07891v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: For two causal structures with the same set of visible variables, one is said to observationally dominate the other if the set of distributions over the visible variables realizable by the first contains the set of distributions over the visible variables realizable by the second. Knowing such dominance relations is useful for adjudicating between these structures given observational data. Here, we consider the problem of determining the partial order of equivalence classes of causal structures with latent variables relative to observational dominance. We provide a complete characterization of the dominance order in the case of three visible variables, and a partial characterization in the case of four visible variables. translated_title: 具有隐变量的因果结构的观测偏序关系
translated_abstract: 对于两个具有相同可见变量集合的因果结构，如果第一个结构能实现的可见变量上的分布集合包含第二个结构能实现的可见变量上的分布集合，则称第一个结构观测支配第二个结构。了解这种支配关系对于根据观测数据在这些结构之间做出判断非常有用。本文研究了确定具有隐变量的因果结构等价类相对于观测支配关系的偏序问题。我们提供了三个可见变量情形下支配序的完整刻画，以及四个可见变量情形下的部分刻画。我们的技术还有助于识别哪些观测等价类具有由非平凡不等式约束刻画的可实现分布集合，这类似于贝尔不等式和...
tldr: 本文研究了具有隐变量的因果结构之间基于观测支配关系的偏序结构，给出了三可见变量情形的完整刻画和四可见变量情形的部分刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the partial order of causal structures with latent variables based on observational dominance, providing a complete characterization for three visible variables and a partial characterization for four visible variables.
